chunks: And all that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to God; and everything is well within the compass of God.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is 'Muheet' (all-encompassing) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nisa underscores the concept of 'Tawhid al-Mulk' (Oneness of Sovereignty), affirming that all dominion belongs exclusively to Allah, a principle often linked to the Imamate as the earthly manifestation of His authority. The attribute 'Muheet' (All-Encompassing) is interpreted not merely as spatial containment but as comprehensive knowledge and power that surrounds all creation, reinforcing the divine justice and guidance available to the faithful.
